commands.speaker: SHIFT TERMINAL
commands.text: 05:17. The overnight exchange should be empty, but three dead lines have begun ringing at once.

commands.speaker: SHIFT TERMINAL
commands.text: Their destination labels were stripped during yesterday's maintenance. The master board will not accept a carrier until all three lines are routed correctly.

commands.speaker: SHIFT TERMINAL
commands.text: Listen to each caller. The operator log on the south-east wall lists where the three trunks terminate.

commands.speaker: SHIFT TERMINAL
commands.text: Booth A is north-west. Booth B is north-east. Booth C is south-west. The master board is south-center.

commands.speaker: SHIFT TERMINAL
commands.text: No supervisor is answering. Sunrise is close.
A brass plate reads: LINE A / MANUAL PATCH.
A brass plate reads: LINE B / MANUAL PATCH.
A brass plate reads: LINE C / MANUAL PATCH.
The master board wakes. Three carrier lamps answer your routes.
LINE A: steady.
LINE B: steady.
LINE C: steady.
All three lamps hold. A fourth circuit, absent from every diagram, begins to hum.
The three callers overlap into one impossible carrier. You have enough signal for one action before sunrise.
You lift the PUBLIC ADDRESS guard and push the fourth switch forward.

options.label: Archive it on the evidence reel

commands.text: You arm the magnetic recorder and leave the public transmitter cold.

elseCommands.text: The fourth circuit stays dead. At least one call is misrouted. The booths can be adjusted as often as needed.

commands.text: The paper log is damp at the corners. Three trunk labels remain legible.
NORTH TRUNK — MERIDIAN OBSERVATORY
EAST TRUNK — BREAKWATER LIGHT
WEST TRUNK — SLEEP CLINIC
Someone has written beneath them in pencil: DO NOT ASK HOW A DISCONNECTED PLACE CAN CALL BACK.
